name: filesystem_mcp
description: Provides tools for reading and writing files on the local filesystem.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the contents of a file at the specified path.

path.description: The absolute or relative path to the file.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write contents to a file at the specified path.

path.description: The absolute or relative path to the file.

content.description: The content to write to the file.
